en.hubeali: Ibn Abu Najran, from Musanna Al Hannat, from Zurara,

(The narrator) says, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man digs a well in other than his kingdom. So a man passed by it and fell into it’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon him is the responsibility, because everyone who digs in other than his own kingdom, upon him would be the responsibility’.
